authorization: The user authorized self-use on public coding tasks, ongoing evidence-backed experiments, and public GitHub/Hugging Face records. This pilot uses existing local ChatGPT Codex login only; no API-key billing, cloud training jobs, new endpoint, or purchased credits.
purpose: Connect a real owned Codex CLI invocation to its private full JSONL, observed process termination and wall time, and independently verified public candidate closure. Compare two explicit requested profiles on three already-authored development tasks before scaling independent task acquisition. This is measurement validation, not evidence from 2400 final routing tasks.

cli.auth: ChatGPT login locally observed. Copy only required auth.json to a fresh private controlled home outside the model workspace; do not publish or hash credentials. API-key auth and unrelated inherited tokens are refused.
cli.inference_network: Parent CLI may contact its configured official service; model-generated commands have no network permission.
cli.model_identity: Requested model/reasoning and exact applied child invocation are recorded separately from provider-observed identity. Current exec JSONL gives no provider-attested model identity; observed_model remains unknown. Model availability cache is not proof of a successful invocation.

execution.limits: All started attempts count, including provider/auth failures, timeout, capture/parse failure and verifier unknown. No silent repeat to improve a result. Parent-process time is measured separately from verifier time; child CPU/RSS if captured is local CLI, never remote model GPU or backend memory. Fixed invocation count and wall limits bound this pilot; monetary/subscription usage is unknown rather than guessed from tokens.

isolation: macOS only until other enforcement is proven. Use current Codex named permissions profile with root deny, platform minimal read, fresh workspace write, temporary and slash-tmp deny, explicit trusted Go toolchain read, generated-command network disabled, never-approval and no user config/rules/skills/MCP/history inheritance. A real offline probe must demonstrate workspace write, sibling read denial and network denial to a live host-control endpoint before inference. No main checkout edits. Kill/wait child process group before candidate snapshot; retain private traces and numeric record, remove copied authentication after terminal cleanup.

routing_hypothesis.method: Score each exact public TaskSpec prompt once before coding outcomes using unchanged pinned base Laya INT8 and existing router threshold0.8. Record probabilities, truncation, suggested/applied tier and abstention as predictions only. Do not select only tasks or profiles which agree with the predictions.

evidence: Use immutable TaskSpec plus independently pinned base and contract tests. Verify after each terminal candidate snapshot; accepted means only this declared closure. Treat unchanged baseline as rejected and unsupported candidate shape/isolation failure as unknown. Preserve exact stdout/stderr byte hashes privately bound to the owned invocation; publish no raw traces/IDs/credentials/local paths/private source. Task outcome records are public numeric/enum reports for these original Apache-2.0 public fixtures only.
analysis: Report all six planned attempts with launched or prelaunch status. A profile success requires process exit0, complete valid core usage and accepted independent closure; keep other observations separately. Compare reported input/cache/output/optional reasoning and time on paired tasks descriptively only, not money/quota. Cached input and reasoning are subsets, never added twice. Failed/incomplete usage remains unknown while observed partial sums survive. Three distinct tasks in two code families are not six independent tasks, population quality proof, model calibration, or a final 2400-case evaluation. Do not fit/train a router on this pilot or reinterpret expected tiers as measured capability.
stop: Refuse before inference on changed CLI binary/version, auth mode, base/spec, unsupported isolation or failed permission probe. Stop remaining scheduled attempts on an executor-integrity, credential-isolation or persistent resource failure; retain all attempted records and explicit unexecuted entries. Individual task rejection alone does not cancel the other fixed comparisons. No threshold/gate relaxation or protected-final scoring.
publication: Branch/PR and exact-head CI quality merge gate; race/vet/format/redacted secrets before push. GitHub records code/plans/numeric results and KO/EN guidance. Model binaries, raw traces, authentication and caches stay local; this cycle creates no new model release or production activation. HF may reference the public research record without claiming new weights or validated routing.
